messages:
sara_sales: FYI Kappa (prospect) sent over their security questionnaire and wants a 2-week POC covering SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and RBAC. They called out domain ownership proof and cross-tenant provisioning as potential blockers. Need scope + ballpark quote to send today. @aj_devx @mike_security can you help?

aj_devx: On it. Quick clarifying q: are they insisting on Dedicated from day 1 or would Hosted w/ private networking suffice for the POC? That changes SCIM rate limits and pricing.

sara_sales: They said "prefer Dedicated for compliance" in the note but said they'd consider hosted for a quick smoke if costs are much lower. So provide two options in the quote.

raj_eng: SCIM notes: they mentioned ~2M users and heavy delta churn. For that scale we should plan a bulk import + delta pipeline and load-test it. On Hosted we'd hit standard SCIM rate limits; Dedicated we can raise the QPS but need autoscale policies. Also need to confirm whether they want group sync vs role-mapping.

mike_security: Security checklist for them to fill asap: send IdP metadata (SAML metadata XML), required assertion attributes (email, sub, groups), expected cert rotation cadence, and whether they need signed/encrypted assertions. Also: they requested KMS/HSM integration and per-user audit trails. We support customer-managed keys in Private; for Hosted we can offer envelope encryption + exportable audit logs. Legal may require annex for HSM.

sara_sales: Sales needs a 1-page POC scope + list of artifacts and a ballpark price band we can share in the deck. Can we get that before EOD?

aj_devx: Draft scope (will tidy):
- 2-week POC: Dedicated mini-pool (reserved) or Hosted dev cluster
- Deliverables: SAML SSO configured, SCIM full import + delta sync, RBAC mapping demo (3 roles + delegated admin), basic audit/log export, performance runbook
- Artifacts we need from Kappa: IdP metadata, sample CSV of roles & groups, domain ownership proof (DNS TXT), expected TPS / daily monthly active users
- Ballpark pricing: Hosted POC ~ $6k-$10k; Dedicated mini-pool POC (reserved infra + support) ~$18k-$28k — depends on GPU count and retention for logs.

raj_eng: Quick sample for the SCIM smoke test (share with their infra):
```
curl -X POST "https://scim.kappa.com/scim/v2/Users" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"userName":"jdoe","emails":[{"value":"jdoe@kappa.com"}],"active":true}'
```

mike_security: Also sharing SAML attribute expectations snippet to send them: we require either NameID=email or persistent uid+email claim. If they plan to send groups, confirm group size limits and whether group membership is nested.

deploy-bot: Created ticket <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-12345|INF-12345> for POC infra provisioning (assign to @raj_eng).

aj_devx: Action items: (1) I'll turn the draft above into a one-pager and attach a decision matrix: Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs. (2) @sara_sales please ask Kappa for IdP metadata + role CSV + domain TXT proof. (3) @mike_security if you can confirm KMS/HSM feasibility and whether Legal needs an HSM addendum we can estimate time to sign.

sara_sales: Perfect. I'll ping them for artifacts now and loop legal. Will update this thread with Kappa's answers. :thumbsup:

mike_security: Quick priority: if they need HSM for POC we should flag legal early — HSM on Private takes extra contract cycles. If they demo with envelope keys on Hosted we can usually avoid that delay.

raj_eng: One more engineering flag: for RBAC mapping we'll need a sample of their role-to-permission mapping. If they want delegated admin across tenants that's an extra engineering effort (timeline + security review).

sara_sales: Copy — I'll ask them to include delegated admin use cases up front. Thanks everyone.
